"""Scratch: a candidate fixed map in a temp root satisfies cases 1 to 3's logic (feasibility only, not committed)."""
import copy
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "tests/acceptance/W2-86"))
import test_w2_86_kernel_template_embedding as t  # noqa: E402

base = yaml.safe_load(subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{t.BASE}:{t.PATH_MAP}"], cwd=t.ROOT, check=True,
                                     capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
ns = base["namespaces"]
kt = ns["kernel-template"]
k = "template/governance/kernel/"
kt["paths"] = ["template/*", "template/.github/**", "template/governance/project/**", "template/openspec/**",
               k + "*", k + "canaries/**", k + "checks/**", k + "hooks/**", k + "launch/**", k + "roles/**",
               k + "schemas/**", k + "templates/**", k + "skills/*/*"]
kt["embedding_policy"] = "embedded"
ven = copy.deepcopy(kt)
ven["paths"] = [k + "vendor/**", k + "bin/**", k + "skills/superpowers/*/**"]
ven["embedding_policy"] = "not embedded"
gen = copy.deepcopy(ven)
gen["paths"] = ["template/.rulesync/**"]
ns["kernel-vendored"], ns["kernel-generated-copies"] = ven, gen

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    root = Path(tmp) / "fixed"
    (root / t.PROJECT_DIR).mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / t.PATH_MAP).write_text(yaml.safe_dump(base, sort_keys=False))
    names = t._namespaces(root)
    tracked = t._tracked(inside=True)
    bad = [r for r in tracked if sum(any(t._matches(r, p) for p in e["paths"]) for e in names.values()) != 1]
    print("not in exactly one:", bad)
    print("bad values:", {n: e.get("embedding_policy") for n, e in names.items()
                          if e.get("embedding_policy") not in t.VALUES})
    (Path(tmp) / "a").mkdir()
    chosen = t._selected(root, tracked, Path(tmp) / "a")
    out = {r for r in tracked if t._vendored(r) or r.startswith("template/.rulesync/")}
    print("kept out but chosen:", sorted(chosen & out))
    print("missing:", sorted(set(tracked) - out - chosen))
    print("counts: tracked", len(tracked), "chosen", len(chosen), "kept out", len(out))
    outside = t._tracked(inside=False)
    (Path(tmp) / "b").mkdir()
    (Path(tmp) / "c").mkdir()
    print("outside diff:", sorted(t._selected(root, outside, Path(tmp) / "b") ^ t._selected(t.ROOT, outside,
                                                                                               Path(tmp) / "c")))
